turnaround_reason: Residential-solar microinverter leader crushed (-19.6% revenue) by the 25D tax-credit reset (US sell-through -34%) plus tariffs; a policy-driven air-pocket rather than a broken business.
bullish_points: Still profitable (~10% net margin) with strong cash (~$938M) through the downturn
Tariff refunds ($45M in Q2) and Propel financing expansion (to ~12 states) partly backfill lost 25D demand
Goldman lifted target to $57; forward P/E ~17 on trough earnings
Franchise brand/margins intact for the eventual policy/demand normalization
bearish_points: Policy overhang (25D expiration) is severe and demand softness expected to persist
US is ~78% of revenue — highly exposed to domestic policy
Solar sentiment fragile; further policy changes possible
catalyst: Stabilization/return of US resi-solar demand as Propel scales and channel digests 25D reset
suggested_trade: Small starter only; patience required for policy/demand to turn
key_risk: Resi-solar demand stays structurally impaired under the new subsidy regime
would_skip_if: You need a near-term catalyst — this is a policy-timing wait
